The problem

2,300,000,000,000 2.3 trillion times a year, someone shakes their mouse because they're stuck.

Every single one of them is free.

We're fixing that. Wiggle is the AI assistant that pops up when you shake your mouse, then charges you based on how frustrated you are.

01 · Problem

When people get stuck, they wiggle. Nobody charges for it.

Lost the cursor

Somewhere on one of three monitors.

Stuck on an error

#REF! in every cell. Nobody knows why.

Deadline in 20 minutes

The most valuable feeling in software.

Each one is a moment of maximum willingness to pay. Today, every one of them is free.

Think:

  • Clippy with a card reader.
  • Surge pricing for confusion.
  • Grammarly, but it reads your whole screen.

02 · How it works

Detect the wiggle. Price the panic.

  1. 1

    Shake your mouse

    Five quick back-and-forth strokes in under a second. Slow moves and drags are ignored.

  2. 2

    Wiggle appears at your cursor

    Your pointer turns into a spinning rainbow arrow. Pick Chat, Screenshot or Voice and ask about whatever's on screen.

  3. 3

    We price the panic

    How fast you shook sets your Frustration Index. Your Frustration Index sets your price.

This part is real
Wiggle is a working Mac app.

The shake detection, the rainbow cursor, screenshots and voice all work today, on Apple Intelligence, local models through Ollama, or your own Claude or OpenAI key. Only the billing is fake. For now.
